input.quote: Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.
input.rationale: No exclusivity, sole-source, or "all requirements" obligation is imposed on Customer anywhere in the Agreement. Searches for "exclusive", "sole supplier", "requirements from", "shall not procure", and "minimum" returned only unrelated uses (warranty exclusivity in § 5.2, nonexclusive licenses in §§ 5.4 and 12.1, and tax-exclusive charges in § 4.3). The charges and services provisions (§§ 4.1, 13.1) contain no volume or sole-source commitment, and § 14.11 restricts only resale of the Services, not Customer's ability to buy from other suppliers. Affirmatively, § 14.16 (Freedom of Action) confirms each party may enter into similar agreements with others, which preserves our freedom to source competing services. This meets the preferred position.
